identity.description: An attacker executes dllhost.exe with an empty command line to bypass security controls and establish persistence. Cortex should detect this anomalous behavior as a potential sign of malicious activity. The attack involves spawning dllhost.exe with no arguments, which is unusual and indicative of a technique used for code execution or lateral movement.
